flashcard_questions.q: What does zinah mean in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: Unlawful sexual activity, including sex outside marriage.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a nikah in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: The Islamic marriage contract agreed between the bride and groom.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the mahr in an Islamic marriage?
flashcard_questions.a: A financial gift given by the groom to the bride.

flashcard_questions.q: What is an annulment in the Catholic Church?
flashcard_questions.a: A declaration that a marriage was never valid in the first place.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the iddah in Islam?
flashcard_questions.a: A three-month waiting period after divorce before a woman may remarry.

flashcard_questions.q: Which verse do Christians use to teach that marriage makes two people one?
flashcard_questions.a: Genesis 2:24 — a man shall be united to his wife and they become one flesh.

flashcard_questions.q: How does the Qur’an 30:21 describe marriage?
flashcard_questions.a: As a source of “love and mercy”.

flashcard_questions.q: Which of the Ten Commandments forbids adultery?
What is the Catholic Church’s position on divorce?
flashcard_questions.a: It does not allow divorce, because marriage is a sacrament.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the Church of England’s position on divorce?
flashcard_questions.a: It permits divorce, and some clergy will remarry divorced people.

flashcard_questions.q: Which teaching of Jesus do Catholics use to reject divorce?
flashcard_questions.a: “What God has joined together, let no one separate” (Mark 10:9).

flashcard_questions.q: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about divorce?
flashcard_questions.a: “Of all the lawful things, divorce is the most hated by Allah.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which Act made same-sex marriage legal in England and Wales?
What proportion of marriages in Britain end in divorce?

flashcard_questions.a: Because sexual relationships outside marriage are forbidden.

notes: 15 cards: 6 term→definition (zinah, nikah, mahr, annulment, iddah, cohabitation), 4 belief→source (Genesis 2:24, Qur’an 30:21, Exodus 20:14, Mark 10:9), 3 denomination→position (Catholic and Anglican divorce, hadith on divorce), 1 statute, 1 statistic. Dropped 'human sexuality' and 'heterosexual' as everyday terms.
